facts.value: Peak holding over 70,000 juan; only about 13,000 left in modern times; 300,000 juan after 1949 (Chinese Wikipedia). English Wikipedia states 300,000 volumes in one sentence and 30,000 in another, so treat as unsettled.
facts.quote: 天一阁一度藏书7万余卷，但到了近代，由于吏治腐败、盗窃和自然损毁，书籍仅存1.3万余卷。
